Cleric.description: A Breath-sworn priest and field physician: prayer, purification and mundane medicine. No active magic (core_rules.txt).
Cleric.lore: Clerics purify Veil corruption in human settlements, clashing with Dark Elves' manipulation.

divine_verdict.description: Deals 15 holy damage, +10 vs corrupted, 1% Breath Overload (-5 stamina, 3 rounds).

Cleric.medicine_note: Cleric healing is mundane: Medicine rank 3 (+15 to surgery and first aid with tools). No limb restoration, no magical healing. Was 'healing_bonus 10' (renamed 2026-11-02).
